title: 港交所CEO：两地市场不是竞争，是互补，企业双上市趋势下谁将受益？
speaker: Bonnie Chan

segments.en: I actually see our relationship quite differently.
segments.zh: 我其实对我们之间的关系有不同的看法。

segments.en: Well, on the face, it seems that we're competing, right?
segments.zh: 表面上我们似乎在竞争，对吧？

segments.en: And that's probably based on the assumption that, you know, a company can only IPO once in their life.
segments.zh: 这可能是基于一种假设，即一家公司一生只能上市一次。

segments.en: However, I think you have picked it up in many of your previous reports.
segments.zh: 不过，我想你在之前的报道中也注意到了。

segments.en: There is a growing trend of companies getting listed on both the Hong Kong market, as well as the Asia market.
segments.zh: 现在越来越多的公司选择在香港和内地市场双重上市。

segments.en: Now, some of them have chosen to do a share listing first and then come to Hong Kong for an each year.
segments.zh: 有些公司先在内地上市，然后再来香港上市。

segments.en: Others have done a share listing and then return to the Chinese mainland for their Asia.
segments.zh: 另一些则先在香港上市，再回到内地。

segments.en: I think regardless of whether, you know, how companies want to sequence it, the what they are pursuing.
segments.zh: 我认为无论公司如何安排顺序，他们追求的都是扩大股东基础。
